verdict.rationale: Docs mention the ability to 'Create custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets, and full-page apps' which touches on dashboard/widget building, but this appears in developer-platform context rather than describing native out-of-the-box reporting features for PMs. Missing for 10: detail on report types (charts, progress bars, timeline widgets), evidence of ease-of-use for non-developer PMs, and independent/hands-on corroboration of dashboard reporting capability.
